alerts.title: Gaza: 340 children killed despite ceasefire agreement - UNICEF
alerts.summary: A little over one year since a ceasefire agreement was announced between Hamas fighters and Israel, more than 340 children have been reported killed and hundreds more injured, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Friday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Sudan’s war spreads as drones and hunger take a deadly toll
alerts.summary: As drone strikes kill civilians from El Obeid to Blue Nile and famine risk spreads across Darfur and Kordofan, the Security Council meets on Sudan – the world’s largest hunger and displacement crisis. Ambassadors are expected to press yet again for a ceasefire, safe aid access and an end to the weapons flows fuelling the brutal conflict.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Deaths, demolitions spike in Gaza, West Bank
alerts.summary: Amid a rise in lethal Israeli strikes, demolitions and violence in Gaza and the West Bank, the Security Council held an open debate on Thursday focusing on the current situation in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

alerts.title: Ukraine: Critical health supplies destroyed in ongoing Russian attacks
alerts.summary: Ongoing and deadly Russian attacks across Ukraine are causing serious healthcare disruption, with more than $1.5 million-worth of medicines and supplies destroyed in four separate strikes on warehouses used by the UN there since July.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Yemen: WFP warns of potential ‘humanitarian catastrophe’ as fighting blocks aid delivery
alerts.summary: Intensifying fighting in Yemen has cut off life-saving assistance to 800,000 people as shifting frontlines, blocked roads and growing insecurity severely restrict access to the city of Taiz and other conflict zones, the UN World Food Programme (WFP) said on Wednesday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: WHO calls for urgent health action across the Eastern Mediterranean
alerts.summary: The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) has called for promoting, providing and protecting health in the Eastern Mediterranean region, home to some of the world’s top humanitarian crises such as Sudan, Yemen and the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

alerts.title: Haiti sanctions renewed: Starving the gangs of bullets
alerts.summary: Haiti is living through one of the world’s most acute security crises. Armed gangs control large parts of the capital, Port-au-Prince, and are pushing into rural areas, terrorising communities, killing people, committing rape and other sexual assaults, kidnapping for ransom and extorting individuals and businesses.

alerts.title: World News in Brief: Gaza braces for winter amid attacks, joint patrols in CAR, 90 cities commit to sustainable development
alerts.summary: The UN and its partners are stepping up preparations in Gaza for the approaching cold and rainy season, even as attacks affecting civilians continue, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said on Wednesday.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Libya in the spotlight amid ‘encouraging progress’
alerts.summary: Despite progress in the political process in Libya, institutional divisions, economic deterioration and security fragility continue to threaten stability, the UN envoy warned the Security Council on Wednesday, calling on Libyan leaders to overcome their differences to pave the way for national elections.

alerts.title: Yemen: Houthi siege, cholera outbreak and aid cuts put civilians in the crosshairs
alerts.summary: Yemen’s southwestern city of Taiz is facing a “devastating” humanitarian crisis as escalating tensions are dramatically driving up food prices and causing shortages of supplies, the UN Spokesperson said on Tuesday.

alerts.title: Ukraine: Residents killed and dozens injured in attacks on Kharkiv and Kyiv
alerts.summary: Russian attacks in recent days on on Ukraine’s two largest cities have again killed and injured civilians, damaged homes and civilian infrastructure, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) said on Tuesday.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Syria’s fragile transition – economic strain, Israeli incursions and progress towards elections
alerts.summary: The Security Council met to debate Syria's thorny transition Monday as it faces pressure on several fronts. Economic hardship is fuelling unrest, Israeli incursions continue in the south and sectarian tensions persist in Sweida, even as Damascus reports progress on its chemical weapons programme and talks about future elections. Millions, meanwhile, remain displaced. Follow live below and go here for full meetings coverage.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Colombia peace deal must endure as insecurity grows, Security Council hears
alerts.summary: Nearly 10 years after Colombia signed a historic peace agreement to end a decades-long insurgency, the deal is under strain from growing insecurity – and the UN’s top official in the country says it cannot be allowed to falter.

alerts.title: Djibouti shipwreck: Death toll rises to 139 as 84 remain missing
alerts.summary: At least 139 migrants have died after their boat capsized off Djibouti, with a further 84 people still missing, the UN migration agency (IOM) said on Sunday.

alerts.title: Sustaining livelihoods amid crisis in Gaza
alerts.summary: Nidaa, Hanaa and Hanin have different stories, but share a common thread: the determination to build something of their own and keep it going despite extraordinary challenges facing them in war-ravaged Gaza.

alerts.title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
alerts.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.

alerts.title: Giving a dam: Cultivating peace in Côte d’Ivoire
alerts.summary: Adam Ouattara and Makongo Traoré have four children and a home on the edge of Torla village in Côte d’Ivoire. He herds cattle. She grows vegetables on a small plot nearby. For years, the dry season pitted their two livelihoods against each other.

alerts.title: UN chief ‘gravely concerned’ by renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia, warns against escalation
alerts.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has called for an immediate end to the renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia, saying he is deeply worried by reports that Eritrean forces are present in the country.

alerts.title: Amid heartache of Nepal flooding disaster, fear remains
alerts.summary: Six weeks after Nepal’s deadly flooding disaster, communities are still struggling to rebuild their lives,&nbsp;but they will need sustained help as global warming increases the risk of another Himalayan catastrophe, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Friday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Yemen has fallen back into full-scale war, warns UN envoy
alerts.summary: The Security Council met to discuss the crisis in Yemen Friday, where a Houthi offensive launched in September has sharply escalated the 12-year-long war for control of the country and spillover from the US-Iran war has provoked a new displacement crisis. Live coverage below and for full meetings updates, go here.

alerts.title: World News in Brief: ‘Horrific’ attack in Sudan, Israeli incursions in Syria intensify, most women and girls homeless in Gaza
alerts.summary: A suspected drone strike has left at least 40 dead in Sudan’s Blue Nile State – near the Ethiopian border - according to initial reports from the ground, according to UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric. Most of the casualties were women and girls.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Cycle of escalating attacks on civilians in Ukraine ‘must end now’
alerts.summary: Escalating violence and human rights violations in the four-year-old Russia-Ukraine war are in the spotlight in the Security Council on Friday following a spate of Russian attacks against civilian targets and infrastructure in recent days.

alerts.title: World News in Brief: Russian attacks continue in Ukraine, Gazans shelter in flood-prone areas, keeping sight of eye health
alerts.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk said on Thursday he was appalled by a wave of attacks that have killed civilians across Ukraine over the past four days.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Darfur: Healthcare needs outstrip resources as Security Council extends Sudan sanctions
alerts.summary: More than 700,000 displaced people in Tawila, in Sudan’s war-ravaged Darfur region, face severe shortages of healthcare, food, water and protection, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Thursday as it called for an urgent increase in resources.

alerts.title: Critical funding gap threatens health response in Yemen
alerts.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) warned that significantly more resources are required to scale up its response in Yemen amid escalating conflict and rising needs.

alerts.title: Ukraine: UN condemns latest attacks and calls for civilian protection
alerts.summary: The UN Humanitarian Coordinator for Ukraine on Wednesday&nbsp;called for an end to attacks against civilians following further overnight strikes by Russian forces that reportedly killed at least 19 in the Chernihiv Region.

alerts.title: Israeli demolition in East Jerusalem displaces 69 Palestinians
alerts.summary: Sixty-nine Palestinians – more than half of them children – were displaced on Tuesday after Israeli authorities green lit the demolition of their residential building in the At Tur area of East Jerusalem, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has reported.

alerts.title: Djibouti faces ‘overlapping emergencies’ as Yemen’s refugee exodus continues
alerts.summary: Djibouti is facing “overlapping emergencies” as refugees fleeing the conflict in Yemen arrive on its shores while migrants continue to travel in the opposite direction, the UN migration agency (IOM) warned on Tuesday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: In Islamabad, Guterres calls for end to US-Iran conflict
alerts.summary: The UN Secretary-General appealed on Tuesday for an end to the United States-Iran war and the toll it has taken on global trade, as he began an official visit to Pakistan.

alerts.title: ‘Nothing can justify these atrocities,’ says Guterres three years on from 7 October attacks
alerts.summary: Three years after Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups attacked Israel, UN Secretary-General António Guterres has said nothing can justify the atrocities of 7 October – calling for an end to the suffering of Israelis and Palestinians alike.

alerts.title: More than 184,000 displaced as fighting intensifies in Yemen
alerts.summary: Intense fighting in Yemen has forced more than 184,000 people from their homes since the start of August, most of them since early September, the UN migration agency (IOM) said on Monday.

alerts.title: ‘The clock on AI regulation is ticking’, warns UN rights chief
alerts.summary: The world is running out of time to put guardrails on artificial intelligence, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk warned Monday, as a “ruthless race” between companies and countries raises concerns about human safety and even humanity’s survival.

alerts.title: Escalating fighting in Yemen deepens food security crisis
alerts.summary: Renewed conflict in Yemen has triggered a surge in hunger that could have consequences in the wider region and beyond, the World Food Programme (WFP) warned on Friday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Gaza: WHO appeals for massive aid influx ahead of winter
alerts.summary: Repeated delays in bringing lifesaving medicines, prosthetics and more from Israel into Gaza risk having devastating consequences on Palestinians who urgently need them in the war-torn enclave, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) said on Friday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: World News in Brief: Cycle of violence continues in Haiti, seafarer deaths off Somalia, food insecurity in the Middle East
alerts.summary: Haitians remain in the grip of lethal gang violence as it continues to “adapt and expand”, the UN’s top rights official, Volker Türk, said on Friday.

alerts.title: World News in Brief: Marshall Islands nuclear legacy, FlyDubai attack condemned, Ukraine update, breast cancer treatment expanded in West Bank
alerts.summary: The enduring radioactive legacy of US nuclear bomb testing in the Marshall Islands took centre stage at the Human Rights Council on Thursday.

alerts.title: ‘Women are not victims’: Türk calls for women to be at the heart of peace and security
alerts.summary: Women must be at the centre of efforts to prevent conflict and build lasting peace, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk said on Thursday.

alerts.title: Palestinians yearn for ‘a return to normal life’, says top Middle East peace envoy
alerts.summary: The UN is continuing efforts to support Palestinians in Gaza amid major challenges to humanitarian access, reconstruction and the restoration of essential services, according to Ramiz Alakbarov, Acting UN Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process.

alerts.title: World News in Brief: Storm clouds over Gaza, deadly obstacles face Mexican women rights defenders, Latvia booze ban proves lifesaver
alerts.summary: UN teams are racing to protect families in Gaza from the coming rainy season, but restricted access to land and shortages of critical supplies are hampering the effort, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Wednesday.

alerts.title: Lebanon: One in five children goes to bed hungry, says UNICEF
alerts.summary: Four in five households in Lebanon struggle to afford basic necessities today, with children increasingly going without food, missing school and being pushed into work as conflict compounds years of economic crisis. "I wanted to buy clothes for my children, but I could not. I also wanted to enrol them in school, but I could not afford that either," said one father of four, cited on Wednesday by the UN Children's Fund (UNICEF).

alerts.title: Yemen escalation fuels fears of further cholera, measles spread
alerts.summary: Heavy fighting in Yemen is fuelling concerns of an uptick in cholera, measles and other preventable diseases, as overcrowding at displacement sites threatens to overwhelm the limited healthcare services still open.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Ambassadors meet as West Bank tensions rise, Gaza plan stalls
alerts.summary: The Security Council met Monday morning with prospects for peace in the Middle East under strain on two fronts. In the West Bank, settler violence and settlement expansion are raising fears for a two-State solution. In Gaza, a year-old peace plan has stalled while civilian suffering continues. The meeting comes as the plan’s remaining phases, including Hamas’ disarmament and Israel’s full withdrawal, remain unimplemented, and as the illegality of settlements under international law remains a key point of contention.

alerts.title: Saudi Arabia warns Gulf security inseparable from global stability amid regional tensions
alerts.summary: Saudi Arabia’s Foreign Minister warned on Saturday that escalating threats across the Middle East risked international peace, energy security and global trade, calling for stronger international cooperation to protect Gulf States and vital shipping routes.

alerts.title: ‘No one speaks on behalf of Lebanon’: PM Salam asserts State authority at UN
alerts.summary: Lebanon’s Prime Minister, Nawaf Salam, has stressed that decisions over war and peace, and control of weapons, must rest solely with the State and its constitutional institutions.

alerts.title: Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis
alerts.summary: Aid agencies in Yemen highlighted the growing hunger emergency sparked by renewed fighting between Houthi opposition forces and Government troops, after mobile health clinics reported that hundreds of children displaced by the violence are suffering from the most deadly form of malnutrition.

alerts.title: UNRWA work and mandate in ‘jeopardy’, Guterres warns
alerts.summary: The UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine refugees (UNRWA) continues to operate under “extraordinary pressure”, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Thursday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’
alerts.summary: Israeli policies now threaten “the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland”, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas told the UN General Assembly on Thursday, urging the world not to allow “another Nakba”.&nbsp;

alerts.title: At UN, Pezeshkian turns terrorism accusation back on Iran’s critics
alerts.summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian opened his General Assembly address with a direct rebuttal to US President Donald Trump, who a day earlier had branded Iran the “number one sponsor of terror.”

alerts.title: ‘Time is running out’ for Israel-Palestine two-State solution
alerts.summary: The UN chief warned on Tuesday that the two-State solution for the Israel-Palestine conflict is at risk of collapse amid illegal Israeli settlement expansion and annexation.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Displacement on the rise in Yemen as fighting continues
alerts.summary: As hostilities worsen in Yemen, more people have been fleeing their homes, further intensifying the humanitarian crisis within the region, the UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR) warned on Tuesday.

alerts.title: UN condemns attempted Houthi strike on Riyadh as Yemen displacement surges past 130,000
alerts.summary: The UN has condemned continued cross‑border attacks by Houthi forces against Saudi Arabia, including an attempted strike on the capital Riyadh, as fighting inside Yemen drives one of the country’s fastest displacement surges in years.
